audience.text: Developers building Node.js applications in TypeScript who need to generate, modify, and export spreadsheet data in Excel-compatible formats.

capabilities.text: Load existing .xlsx files and HTML files using Workbook.load() and save workbooks back to .xlsx using Workbook.save().
capabilities.title: Load and save Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Read and write cell values, formulas, and shared strings using Cell.putValue(), Cell.setFormula(), and Cell.setSharedStrings().
capabilities.title: Cell data manipulation

capabilities.text: Apply comprehensive formatting including font, fill, border, alignment, number formats, and protection through Style, Font, Fill, Border, and Alignment objects.
capabilities.title: Full cell and range styling

capabilities.text: Configure column widths, row heights, merged cells, auto filters, hidden rows, and default dimensions using Worksheet methods.
capabilities.title: Worksheet configuration

capabilities.text: Apply data validation rules and conditional formatting including color scales, data bars, and icon sets to cell ranges.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Add hyperlinks and comments to cells using Worksheet.addHyperlink() and Worksheet.addComment() with corresponding collection management.
capabilities.title: Hyperlink and comment support

capabilities.text: Export workbook data to CSV, JSON, and Markdown formats using Workbook.toCsv(), Workbook.toJson(), and Workbook.toMarkdown().
capabilities.title: Text export formats

capabilities.text: Import HTML files into workbooks using Workbook.load() and export styled HTML documents using Workbook.toHtml().
capabilities.title: HTML import and export

limitations.text: Text export (CSV, JSON, Markdown) returns strings only; no direct file-writing helpers are provided.
Text export is one-way; there is no corresponding import path to load CSV, JSON, or Markdown back into a Workbook.
The package has not been published to npm; installation must be performed from source.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and modification in TypeScript/Node.js environments without Microsoft Excel installed.
Provides a familiar API surface for developers experienced with Aspose.Cells, supporting Workbook, Worksheet, Cell, and Style objects.
Supports exporting workbook data to common text-based formats (CSV, JSON, Markdown) for reporting and data interchange.
Allows importing HTML files and exporting workbooks as styled HTML documents for web-based reporting.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for TypeScript is a free, open-source TypeScript library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The repository does not specify minimum Node.js version requirements beyond TypeScript 5 or later being required.
Support for embedded charts, pivot tables, and other advanced Excel features is not confirmed by the available public symbols.
The exact scope of Excel formula calculation support is not evident from the available symbols.
Whether the library supports password-protected or encrypted workbooks is not specified in the public symbols.
The behavior of Workbook.load() when auto-detecting HTML files is not detailed beyond the format fact.
The extent of image and shape support beyond Workbook.images and Worksheet.shapes collections is not detailed.
The library's handling of multiple worksheets beyond basic collection operations is not fully evident.
Whether conditional formatting rules support custom formulas beyond the documented types is not confirmed.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, add data to cells using Worksheet.getCell2() or Worksheet.putValue(), apply styles via Cell.setStyle(), and save as .xlsx using Workbook.save().

workflows.name: Load and modify existing workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file using Workbook.load(), access cells via Worksheet.getCellByRef() or Worksheet.getCell(), update values or formulas, and save changes.

workflows.name: Apply formatting and styling
workflows.text: Create Style objects with Font, Fill, Border, and Alignment properties, then assign them to cells using Cell.setStyle() or Worksheet.setCellStyle().

workflows.name: Export to text formats
workflows.text: Call Workbook.toCsv(), Workbook.toJson(), or Workbook.toMarkdown() to obtain string representations of workbook data for external processing or file writing.

workflows.name: Configure worksheet features
workflows.text: Set column widths, row heights, merged cells, auto filters, and hidden rows using Worksheet methods like setColumnWidth(), setRowHeight(), mergeCells(), and setAutoFilter().

workflows.name: Add data validation and conditional formatting
workflows.text: Create DataValidation and ConditionalFormat objects, add them to Worksheet.dataValidations and Worksheet.conditionalFormats collections, and apply rules to cell ranges.
